candidate.definition_en: A fine open fabric of cotton or silk; also a cord used to tie shoes.
candidate.explanation_ar: قماش الدانتيل المزخرف، أو الرباط اللي بنربط بيه الجزمة.

senses.definition_en: A delicate, decorative fabric made of yarn or thread in an open web-like pattern.
senses.explanation_ar: قماش الدانتيل المزخرف المفرغ بخيوط دقيقة.
examples: Her wedding dress was decorated with delicate white lace.
Sunlight streamed into the room through the sheer lace curtains.

senses.definition_en: A cord or string used for fastening or tying shoes or boots.
examples: The lace on his running shoe snapped when he pulled it.
Her wedding dress was decorated with delicate white lace.
The lace on his running shoe snapped when he pulled it.
Sunlight streamed into the room through the sheer lace curtains.
candidate.mnemonic: زي 'Necklace' 'عقد'.. الـ 'Lace' زينة زي العقد، أو رباط.
